summary: xAI released Grok 4.6, an incremental update to Grok 4.5 focused on long-running agentic tasks and visual/interactive work, with new pricing and availability via API and partners.

mechanisms.reason: The model card discloses a longer supplemental training run than the prior version, implying additional training compute was committed.
mechanisms.quote: Grok 4.6 underwent a longer supplemental training run than Grok 4.5, with curated model-generated data for reasoning and advanced technical concepts, high-quality engineering data, and an improved optimizer and training recipe.

practices.reason: The model shows stated benchmark gains on agentic coding and knowledge-work tasks, relevant to teams building coding and agent products.
practices.quote: Grok 4.6 achieves frontier intelligence across several agentic coding and knowledge work benchmarks.

practices.reason: The release names a wide set of third-party and lab benchmarks (Terminal-Bench, DeepSWE, CursorBench, APEX-Agents) that a team could examine to calibrate its own evaluation suite.
